verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single marketing line saying Shopify POS lets merchants customize printed receipts, so printed receipts are a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack covers email or SMS receipts, or receipt content that meets card-network requirements. Missing for 10: email/SMS digital receipt delivery, documentation of card-network-compliant receipt fields, in-depth receipt docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements

citations.quote: Easily customize printed receipts to fit your brand.
